easyPrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Indoraptor.
description:
Deal damage to Indoraptor.
Indoraptor and Blazing Sunsteel trigger.
Resolve the Indoraptor trigger, dealing damage to an opponent unless they sacrifice a nontoken creature.
Resolve the Blazing Sunsteel trigger, dealing damage to Indoraptor.
Repeat from step 2.
